items.title: Ciena (CIEN) Completes Quantum Safe Networking Trial With Toshiba And Quantum Corridor
items.summary: Ciena (NYSE:CIEN) completed a trial of quantum-safe networking with Quantum Corridor Inc. and Toshiba International Corporation. The test combined Ciena's WaveLogic 6 Extreme platform with Toshiba's quantum key distribution encryption technology. The trial focused on providing quantum-safe data protection for enterprises and service providers facing rising cybersecurity risks.
